provinces.scope: The semantic physics of the archive itself — rooms, chambers, fields, heteronym provenance, and the instruments that constitute the place rather than publish into it.
provinces.rationale: A journal is a venue one publishes INTO; a province is a jurisdiction the archive publishes FROM. Archive-constitutive work is not a submission and has no venue. This keeps the journal family at seven and explains why 'CHA' read as wrong in a journal field: the field was being asked to hold a category it does not take.
